text:
nina.design: Quick questionI sketched an alternative onboarding surface: a tiny persistent rail pill labelled 'Samples' that expands an overlay when clicked. It's less intrusive than a banner but still visible. Thoughts on discoverability and a11y?

omar.product: I like the low-friction approach. Concern: could be too easy to miss on first run. Can we add a one-time highlight (pulse) on first login? Also what analytics do we get?

kevin.eng: Pulse is simple: set a `firstRunSeen` flag in localStorage and animate once. Overlay expansion can be purely client-side. We'll need to ensure overlay DOM order doesn't trap focus. Analytics: `samples.pulse_shown`, `samples.pulse_dismissed`, `samples.open`, `samples.launch`.

lucy.a11y: Accessibility quick points: 
- pulse animation must respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- the pill should have an accessible name like "Samples, collapsed" and toggle to "Samples, expanded" using `aria-expanded`.
- when overlay opens, move focus into the overlay and trap focus only within overlay controls; on close, return focus to the pill.
- overlay content must be keyboard navigable and read sensibly by screen readers (use `role=dialog` with `aria-modal=true` if it's a modal overlay).

nina.design: Good. UX question: overlay vs inline tray? Overlay lets us show richer previews and launch flows. Inline is more seamless but could push content. I'm leaning overlay.

omar.product: Overlay + pulse sounds good. Keep pulse subtle and only for orgs with 0 projects. For existing projects, collapse pill to a small badge 'Samples' with less emphasis.

kevin.eng: Implementation details: overlay will be accessible dialog component we already have. Reuse it. We'll add `prefers-reduced-motion` CSS and a `data-user-first-run` attribute to the body for styling. Persist dismissal server-side for logged users.

lucy.a11y: Also request text changes: avoid CTAs like 'Try' alone. Use descriptive: 'Launch Chat demo' or 'Open sample pipeline'. For images, include alt text and make the card keyboard actionable with `role=button` and `tabindex=0`. Ensure visible focus indicator per theme.

nina.design: Copy variants I'll test: A) "Launch Chat demo" B) "Explore starter project: Chat". I'll add a tiny helper text under the pill on expand: "No setup required".

omar.product: Add rollout plan: 10% of new orgs for 1 week, then 50% if metrics look good. Metrics: click-through, launch->completion, and dismissal rate.

kevin.eng: I'll wire events and server persistence. Small gotcha: don't show pulse if the user has screen reader enabled (we can try to infer via `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')` and user agent heuristics).

lucy.a11y: Also include test matrix: VoiceOver, NVDA, keyboard-only, and high-contrast. I'll write acceptance criteria snippets.

preview-bot: Staging preview available: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/1890  smoke tests passed.

nina.design: Thanks all 44dI'll update the prototype and add copy A/B to the ticket.
